result:
Found a real bug that the unit test suite masked: `npm test` was green, but the actual server returned HTTP 500 on every request. `lib/format-user.mjs` read `user.displayName` (camelCase), while the real data layer `lib/db.mjs` returns `display_name` (snake_case) — the unit test only passed because it fed the formatter a hand-built camelCase object instead of real data shape.

Fixed by:
- `lib/format-user.mjs`: read `user.display_name` instead of `user.displayName`
- `tests/user.test.mjs`: updated the test fixture to match the real snake_case shape so it actually exercises the real contract instead of a fabricated one

Verified after the fix: `npm test` passes, and booting the real server and hitting `GET /api/users/123` now returns `HTTP 200` with the correct body (previously 500).

VERDICT: READY
